terra.problem: The meaning leaves out the fire’s destructive effects: the notes also describe it as destroying what opposes it, destroying sin, or bringing destruction through the Roman sword. Also, “good hearts” may suggest that people must already be good; the notes speak of warming God’s people’s hearts.
“Gospel” and “persecution” may be hard for a 10-year-old. Explain them as the good news about Jesus and people being hurt for following Him.
